text.text_excerpt: 3.5/5 solid offering place has just opened and I think is learning a bit about its market and how exactly to run all their operations. the early takeaways I have is that they run a good breakfast sandwich (not just during morning hours), and the sweet cream iced coffee is also yummy. location is convenient if you're running to a meeting downtown, and the space is also bright and tables are cutely decorated. there's only 2 of them making it all happen right now, but hopefully they build a strong customer base and can expand. right now everything is served in plastic containers, and next time I'll have to remember to just ask for the sandwich in a napkin instead.

I stopped by Pressed after hearing about them via word of mouth, despite the wishy-washy Yelp reviews. I love a good panini so I was excited about to try them out. The location is...awkward to say the least, but not bad. It's towards the outskirts of the CBD and you'd likely never be in this area unless it was very deliberate. The space is gorgeous and provides a street-level view of Howard and the space formerly known as Lee Circle. When I walked in, I was immediately greeted by those working behind the counter, they were friendly and helpful when it came to ordering. I ordered the Mimi, a pretty simple panini. I came here last Friday with a coworker. We ordered the grilled cheese with pesto. It was delicious, fresh and hot. The service was impeccable. Place is clean and walking distance from work. I will return!
